from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A parsed paper from the collection, containing its relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly cites (Reference)")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers that explicitly cite this paper (Citation)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
